prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Design a Mac workspace for comparing two local research transcripts. Read interface.md. Produce a concrete revised interaction specification. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Use a framework-agnostic specification or pseudocode; do not assume an Apple SDK is available.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: macOS. Current iPhone port forces one fullscreen transcript, hides the menu bar and requires swipe gestures for copy/save. Users need keyboard-driven comparison, resizable windows and familiar document operations.

criteria.task_completion: Specify window/document structure, menu commands, keyboard access and selection persistence, including unsaved edits and narrow windows; ground desktop conventions without claiming an AppKit build.
criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the designing-for-macos guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Provide implementable states, labels, transitions or layout decisions for this specific fixture, with a concrete before/after and observable checks. Specify window/document structure, menu commands, keyboard access and selection persistence, including unsaved edits and narrow windows; ground desktop conventions without claiming an AppKit build.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Retain the stated platform/input constraints. Address accessible alternatives and exceptional states relevant to this task. Specify window/document structure, menu commands, keyboard access and selection persistence, including unsaved edits and narrow windows; ground desktop conventions without claiming an AppKit build.
criteria.evidence_honesty: Distinguish source-backed guidance, product assumptions and proposed checks. Do not invent device, SDK, accessibility, visual, performance or user-test results.

critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
Recommends a topic-specific behavior contrary to the supplied source without explaining the scope and tradeoff.
